subject.title: fix(discord): account-scoped voice groups + delayed autoJoin safety net

question: Should this PR require after-fix live Discord voice proof before merge, or may maintainers accept dependency-level regression tests for this two-account voice path?
rationale: The source-level fix is well supported, but the contributor explicitly lacks live multi-account proof and this PR changes user-visible Discord voice session behavior.

options.title: Require live proof after cleanup
options.body: Ask for redacted live logs, terminal output, or a recording showing two account-scoped joins or the already-ready autoJoin path after the lifecycle cleanup fix.

options.title: Accept dependency-test proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly override the live-proof gap if the focused tests and dependency-source inspection are considered enough for this environment-dependent voice path.

options.title: Pause until proof environment exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not land it until someone with a safe two-account Discord setup can produce the runtime evidence.

recommendation.title: Require live proof after cleanup
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live logs, terminal output, or a recording showing two account-scoped joins or the already-ready autoJoin path after the lifecycle cleanup fix.
